body:
Hey @dromer :wave:,
Thank you for opening an issue. We will get back to you as soon as we can.
Also, check out our [Open Collective](https://opencollective.com/celery) and consider backing us - every little helps!

We also offer priority support for our sponsors.
If you require immediate assistance please consider sponsoring us.

> I'm still +1 on Gitter with bridges to other clients.

With "bridges" you mean a bot that copies messages back and forth?
Those ruin chat and I'm 100% against that.

Actually I think gitter is all based on Matrix these days, so you can create a Matrix channel that actually bridges (as in connects the network and its users) to libera.chat and gitter (afaik)

Please don't use a bot, you will lose people if that's how you think chat should work.

What do you mean with relay?

Gitter used to have an irc-gateway you could connect to with an irc client, but I don't think that's still the case.

## Description

For the moment, it seems best to have the IRC link in the README pointing at a location where the community is congregating. Further discussion on #6811 or a follow on issue can track other platforms and bridging.

Ref #6811
